name: Magus
backstory: Keeps the temple at the crossing, tending rites that predate any living memory of who actually built the place.

experience.text: Had a child with Nierius, named Niergus.
Heard that Fenserika and Nierius now have a child, Fenrius.
Heard that Nakus and Darnus now have a child, Darnukas.
Heard that Nakus and Niemus now have a child, Niekus.
Heard that Nakus and Prince Doran now have a child, Dornakus.
Had a child with Nierius, named Nieragus.
Heard that Prince Doran and Nakus now have a child, Nakoran.

criterion.standard: counts remembering what a place actually cost someone above who gets credit for it
criterion.wasted_life: tending rites at a temple whose own builders got forgotten
criterion.origin: collision between his backstory (keeps the temple) and the sample's own CONFLICT-02 (who actually built it)
criterion.trusts: a story that's been carried and retold and still holds together
criterion.distrusts: a record that insists on a precision no one who was actually there ever needed

routines.routine_actions: opens the temple before dawn, tends the old rites, answers pilgrims' questions about a history he can't fully vouch for

needs: access to the temple's oldest foundation, buried under later repairs
arc.premise: Magus wants to find the temple's own foundation stone, whatever mark it carries, and settle with his own eyes whose hands actually laid it first - not another retelling, the stone itself.
